title: Free Issue Closing Build Plan
approval: Build plan approved: free issue closing

short.lead: The close guard changes in four steps, one GitHub issue each, under parent #548 (Free issue closing). All work is on the branch AjsAgent/free-issue-closing.
short.hint: Tap a step to see it.
items: #549: one GitHub lookup per group of closes
Reads every open issue's labels and milestone in one call and keeps them for 60 seconds, so a mass close makes one call. If GitHub cannot be reached, the close is refused.
An issue with no milestone closes when it carries needs review, in review or a completed label the agent did not add itself. Anything else is refused, naming why.
#551: Close approved messages and milestone closes
Your "Close approved: #N" lets that issue close. Your "Close approved: milestone N" lets that milestone close. Without them, both are refused.
The rule the agent reads, rule 6 in issue-workflow.md, the systems doc and CHANGELOG.md describe the new behaviour.

changes: One paginated gh api read, cached in .git/house-rules-issue-cache.json for 60 seconds.
Done when: a verify.py case shows ten closes in a row make one GitHub read, and a failed read refuses the close.
Allows reviewed or completed issues with no milestone; ignores completed labels the agent added.
Done when: verify.py cases pass for needs review (allowed), in progress (refused), a milestone issue (refused) and a self-added completed label (refused), on both the gh and GitHub-tool routes.
#551: approval messages and the milestone guard
Records "Close approved" messages and refuses an unapproved milestone close.
Done when: verify.py cases show an approved issue and milestone close, and an unapproved milestone close is refused.
The written rule matches the new guard; the plugin version goes up.
Done when: verify.py passes in full.

wrapup.summary: Four steps that let the agent close reviewed or completed issues on its own, while milestone issues and milestones wait for you.
wrapup.changing: The close guard in design_loop.py, its checks, the rule text and three docs.
